segments.name: Advanced materials
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells custom advanced material solutions, primarily metal matrix composites, to electronics assemblers, microelectronics systems houses and armor manufacturers.
segments.evidence: The Company produces and sells advanced material solutions, primarily metal matrix composites, to assemblers of high density electronics and other specialty components and subassemblies.

revenueModel.text: Customers, mainly global electronics OEMs and microelectronics systems houses, pay CPS for custom, build-to-order advanced material components and armor products made to their specifications.
revenueModel.evidence: Operationally, the Company typically follows a build-to-order, highly customized manufacturing model, supported by ongoing investments in employee training, automation, and process efficiency.
